s1_netrev: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) AS net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3,4)
s1_netrev_p2: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) AS net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3,4)
s1_netrev_p3: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) AS net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3,4)
s1_aov: SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3,4)) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3,4)) AS aov
s1_aov_p2: SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3,4)) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3,4)) AS aov
s1_aov_p3: SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3,4)) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3,4)) AS aov
s1_margin: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate) - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) AS gross_margin FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key WHERE o.status IN (3,4)
s1_active_cust: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_key) AS active_customers FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3,4)
s1_active_p2: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_key) AS active_customers FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3,4)
s1_active_p3: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_key) AS active_customers FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3,4)
s1_gross_rev: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS gross_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3,4)
s1_orders: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3,4)
s1_top_customer: SELECT o.customer_key AS customer_id, c.full_name AS customer_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) AS net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_key = c.customer_id WHERE o.status IN (3,4) GROUP BY o.customer_key, c.full_name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 1
s2_shipping_total: SELECT SUM(o.shipping_fee) AS shipping_fee_total FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3,4)
s2_shipping_region: SELECT o.ship_region, SUM(o.shipping_fee) AS shipping_fee_total FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3,4) GROUP BY o.ship_region ORDER BY o.ship_region
s2_rev_and_ship: SELECT COALESCE(r.ship_region, s.ship_region) AS ship_region, r.net_revenue, s.shipping_fee_total FROM (SELECT o.ship_region, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) AS net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3,4) GROUP BY o.ship_region) r FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT o.ship_region, SUM(o.shipping_fee) AS shipping_fee_total FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3,4) GROUP BY o.ship_region) s ON r.ship_region = s.ship_region ORDER BY ship_region
s2_lines: SELECT COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3,4)
s2_ship_pct: SELECT (SELECT SUM(o.shipping_fee) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3,4)) / (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3,4)) * 100 AS shipping_pct_of_net_revenue
s2_avg_line_disc: SELECT SUM(o.shipping_fee) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS avg_shipping_fee_per_order FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3,4)
s3_refund_total: SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_total FROM returns r
s3_refund_by_cat: SELECT p.category AS product_category, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_total FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id AND r.line_number = oi.line_number JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category
s3_refund_units: SELECT SUM(r.return_qty) AS refund_qty FROM returns r
s3_net_of_refunds: SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3,4)) - (SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount) FROM returns r) AS net_revenue_after_refunds
s3_refund_rev_by_cat: SELECT COALESCE(a.product_category, b.product_category) AS product_category, a.net_revenue, b.refund_total FROM (SELECT p.category AS product_category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) AS net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key WHERE o.status IN (3,4) GROUP BY p.category) a FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT p.category AS product_category, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_total FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id AND r.line_number = oi.line_number JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY p.category) b ON a.product_category = b.product_category ORDER BY product_category
s5_ship_pct_region: SELECT COALESCE(r.ship_region, s.ship_region) AS ship_region, s.shipping_fee_total / r.net_revenue * 100 AS shipping_pct_of_net_revenue FROM (SELECT o.ship_region, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) AS net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3,4) GROUP BY o.ship_region) r FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT o.ship_region, SUM(o.shipping_fee) AS shipping_fee_total FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3,4) GROUP BY o.ship_region) s ON r.ship_region = s.ship_region ORDER BY ship_region
